en.title: Three Steps of Land | Vamana and Bali
en.description:
What if the smallest request is the biggest one?

Vishnu came as a small boy and asked King Bali for just three steps of land.

Retold from the Bhagavata Purana, Canto 8, chapters 15-22.

Subscribe for a new Purana story every day.
